info.name: For Taxpayers-GRA E-VAT API - VER 8.2
info.description:
This document (GRA E-VAT API Documentation or E-VAT API Documentation or VCIS/VSDC API Documentation) describes the API specification for the integration of Taxpayer systems to the Commissioner-General's Electronic Invoicing Systems (E-VAT).

OVERVIEW
The following specific requirements are for the systems to communicate with E-VAT VCIS, the Certified Invoicing System to be used together with a Virtual Sales Data Controller (VSDC).

Data Flow Diagram

AUTHENTICATION
This API requires an Authentication in the Request Header
Example: "security_key": "1234567890987UIEGRTEIIIWOWPPWOOW"

The security key is a static value that will be expected across all endpoints that data is sent, whenever a request is made.

DATA FORMAT
E-VAT API Receives accepts payloads in any of the formats below:

  1. JSON

  2. XML

DEPLOYMENT TYPE
Taxpayers are allowed to choose between the cloud deployment and the On-Prem deployment.
Cloud Deployment is where GRA hosts the software that stamps your E-VAT invoices
On-Prem Deployment is where the taxpayer provides a server, either within their network (preferably) or a dedicated private cloud server.
The EVAT Team recommends for taxpayers that issue huge number of invoices within a day to opt for the On-Prem Deployment

ON-PREM DEPLOYMENT MINIMUM HARDWARE SPECIFICATION

  • HDD: 500GB

  • RAM: 8GB

  • OS: Windows Server 2019 + / Windows 10 +

LEVY MAPPING

  • levyAmountA : NHIL 2.5 %

  • levyAmountB: GETFL 2.5 %

  • levyAmountC : COVID 1% (Applies to invoice dates before 1st January 2026)

  • levyAmountD : CST 5%

  • levyAmountE : TOURISM LEVY 1%

TAG DESCRIPTION

TAG NAME TAG VALUE EXAMPLE TAG DESCRIPTION LENGTH AND TYPE MANDATORY
"currency" "GHS" Currency: GHS, USD, EUR or GBP VARCHAR(20) YES
"exchangeRate" 1.00 Current exchange rate: default 1 for GHS NUMERIC YES
"invoiceNumber" "INV_26_001" Software unique transaction identifier VARCHAR(100) YES
"totalLevy" 30.00 Total levy amount (summation of levies a, b, c, d, e) NUMERIC YES
"userName" "happy" User name VARCHAR(100) YES
"flag" "INVOICE" This determines the type of transaction about to be sent. Examples: "INVOICE", "PURCHASE", "REFUND" (full cancellation), "PARTIAL_REFUND" (partial cancellation), "PURCHASE_RETURN", "REFUND_CANCELLATION". This is a case sensitive field. VARCHAR(20) YES
"calculationType" "INCLUSIVE" "INCLUSIVE" or "EXCLUSIVE". Where unit price has tax embedded (INCLUSIVE) or tax not included (EXCLUSIVE). Case sensitive. VARCHAR(20) YES
"totalVat" 13.04 Total VAT of the invoice: Summation of 15% value for all taxable items NUMERIC YES
"transactionDate" "2026-02-28" Invoice date (posted date is the one used) VARCHAR(50) YES
"totalAmount" 100.0 Total amount on the invoice. Strictly the summation of unit price × quantity regardless of calculation type. NUMERIC YES
"voucherAmount" 0.0 Voucher amount NUMERIC NO
"totalExciseAmount" 600 Total excise amount on the invoice NUMERIC YES if excise duty is applicable
"businessPartnerName" "James Kofi" Customer / Supplier name VARCHAR(100) YES
"businessPartnerTin" "C00000009055" Client's TIN or Ghana card number VARCHAR(15) YES
"saleType" "NORMAL" "NORMAL" for general case, "EXPORT" for export invoice. Case sensitive. VARCHAR(20) YES
"discountType" "GENERAL" "SELECTIVE" (discount on total amount, taxable) or "GENERAL" (discount per line, tax exempt). Case sensitive. VARCHAR(300) NO
"discountAmount" 0.0 Total discounted amount on invoice NUMERIC NO
"groupReferenceId" "" Reference ID to group invoices together under one main identifier VARCHAR(50) NO
"reference" "RF_INV_26_001" Refund ID for full or partial refunds. Identifies the refund transaction. VARCHAR(50) YES – For Refunds and Returns Only
"itemCode" "TXC005918138" Item code: unique value identifying an item VARCHAR(50) YES
"itemCategory" "" "" (standard 20%), "CST" (5% comms tax), "TRSM" (1% tourism), "EXM" (zero rated/exempt), "RNT" (rent), "EXC_PLASTIC" (plastic with excise duty). Case sensitive. VARCHAR(50) YES
"expireDate" "" Expiry date of an item if applicable VARCHAR(45) NO
"description" "Bowl" Name of the item VARCHAR(100) YES
"quantity" 10.0 Quantity of the item NUMERIC YES
"levyAmountA" 2.05 Levy amount on NHIL (2.5%) NUMERIC YES
"levyAmountB" 2.05 Levy amount on GETFUND (2.5%) NUMERIC YES
"levyAmountC" 0.8 Levy amount on COVID (1%) – Only for invoices created before 1st January 2026 NUMERIC YES
"levyAmountD" 0.0 Levy amount on CST (5%) NUMERIC YES
"levyAmountE" 0.0 Levy amount on tourism (1%) NUMERIC YES
"discountAmount" 0.0 Discount amount on item NUMERIC NO
"exciseAmount" 10 Excise duty amount on item NUMERIC (Not specified)
"batchCode" "5MAKD1" Batch number if applicable VARCHAR(100) NO
"unitPrice" 10.0 Unit selling price of item (inclusive or exclusive of tax) NUMERIC YES

SUCCESS RESPONSE DESCRIPTION:

FIELD LABEL DESCRIPTION
"distributor_tin" TIN TIN of Taxpayer issuing the invoice
"num" Invoice Number ERP/PoS Invoice Number as sent to the VSDC
"ysdcid" SDC ID The unique identifier of the SDC (Sales Data Controller) issuing the E-VAT Signature
"ysdcrecnum" Receipt Number The Receipt Number issued by the SDC
"ysdcintdata" Internal Data References the Internal Data of the Invoice
"ysdcregsig" Signature Invoice Signature
"ysdcmrc" MRC Machine Registration Code
"ysdcmrctime" MRC Date & Time Date/Time invoice is received at the backend
"ysdctime" Date & Time Date/Time invoice is stamped
"flag" (empty) Type of Invoice
"ysdcitems" Line-Item Count Number of Line-Items on the invoice
"qr_code" URL link to be converted to QR Code Image The QR code must be clear and readable, with a minimum size of 2.5 cm × 2.5 cm. GRA may require a larger size in some cases.
"status" (empty) Status of invoice request

item.description:
This includes Partial and Full Refunds

FULL REFUND

A Full Refund refers to a situation where a customer receives complete reimbursement of the total amount they paid for a product or service. It means that the seller or service provider returns the entire purchase price to the customer.

PARTIAL REFUND
A Partial Refund refers to a situation where a customer receives a refund for only a portion of the total amount they paid for a product or service.

item.name: REFUND CANCELLATION
item.description:
REFUND CANCELLATION

A Refund Cancellation typically refers to the reversal or annulment of a previously issued refund. It occurs when a seller or service provider decides to nullify or revoke a refund that was previously processed and returned to the customer.

item.description:
PURCHASE RETURN

A Purchase Return refers to the act of reversing or nullifying a previously made purchase. It occurs when a buyer or customer decides to cancel their order or transaction.

item.name: PURCHASE RETURN CANCELLATION
item.description:
PURCHASE RETURN CANCELLATION

A Purchase Return Cancellation refers to the reversal or nullification of a previously initiated return of goods or services. It occurs when a buyer or customer decides to cancel their request to return a purchased item or cancel a return process that was already initiated.

item.name: CREDIT NOTE/DEBIT NOTE
item.description:
CREDIT/DEBIT NOTE

A Credit Note, also known as a Credit Memo, is a document issued by a seller or service provider to a customer as a form of credit or refund. It is typically provided when there is a need to rectify a previous transaction, such as returning goods, resolving a billing error, or providing compensation for a service issue. Whereas Refunds (Partial & Full) can only be done on a single invoice, Credit/Debit Notes are used in situations where the said refund/credit applies to multiple invoices.

TAG DESCRIPTIONS

TAG NAME TAG VALUE EXAMPLE TAG DESCRIPTION LENGTH AND TYPE MANDATORY
"noteNumber" "0948468491" UNIQUE IDENTIFIER FOR CREDIT/DEBIT NOTE TRANSACTION VARCHAR(50) YES
"currency" "GHS" CURRENCY VARCHAR(20) YES
"exchangeRate" 1 CURRENT EXCHANGE RATE: DEFAULT VALUE is 1.00 FOR GHS 10 YES
"noteAmount" 200.0 TOTAL AMOUNT ON CREDIT/DEBIT NOTE NUMERIC YES
"userName" "happy" USER NAME VARCHAR(100) YES
"calculationType" "EXCLUSIVE" "EXCLUSIVE", "INCLUSIVE". A Case Sensitive Field. When omitted or left empty, "INCLUSIVE" is applied by default. VARCHAR(20) NO
"flag" "CREDIT_NOTE" TRANSACTION TYPE: "CREDIT_NOTE", "DEBIT_NOTE". A Case Sensitive Field. VARCHAR(20) YES
"noteLineFlag" "INVOICE" "INVOICE" or "PURCHASE". A Case Sensitive Field. When omitted or left empty, "INVOICE" is applied by default. VARCHAR(20) NO
"businessPartnerName" "James Kofi" CLIENT NAME VARCHAR(100) YES
"businessPartnerTin" "VC00000009055" CLIENT TIN OR GHANA CARD NUMBER VARCHAR(15) YES B2B, NO B2C
"groupReferenceId" "2390957437" REFERENCE ID TO A GROUP OF INVOICES VARCHAR(50) NO
"transactionDate" "2023-06-14" DATE OF TRANSACTION VARCHAR(50) YES
"remarks" "" REMARKS VARCHAR(100) NO

"invoiceDate" "2023-06-14" INVOICE DATE (POSTED DATE IS THE ONE USED) VARCHAR(50) YES

item.name: STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT
item.description:
STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT

A Statement of Account is a summary of financial transactions and activity between a seller or service provider and a customer over a specific period. It is used to track the folio of a particular customer. IMPLEMENTED FOR THE HOSPITALITY INDUSTRIES, this allows for a single invoice (i.e.: a combination of all invoices from the PMS & PoS) to be printed at the end of a stay.

TAG DESCRIPTIONS

item.name: ERRORS
item.description:
STATUS CODE ERROR CODE ERROR MESSAGE SOLUTION
200 - - -
403 - FORBIDDEN Ensure Company Reference in the URL is accompanied by its matching security_key in the Header
400 - BAD REQUEST Ensure you do not have a broken URL / Endpoint
400 E600 Something went wrong Contact tech support team
400 E601 Unable to generate internal data Contact tech support team
400 E602 Unable to generate a signature Contact tech support team
400 E603 TLS version not supported Contact tech support team
400 E700 The invoice has already been signed Ensure that you are sending an invoice number that has not already been sent to EVAT (Rely on callback endpoint to get a copy of success response)
400 E701 The invoice was not found Ensure that the invoice number in question has been sent to evat and returned with a success response
400 E702 Invalid data, invoices already exist Ensure you insert an invoice number that has not been sent to EVAT
400 E703 Invalid number of items for statement of account reference Ensure all transactions tied to the group reference ID are present in the payload
400 E704 The transaction was not found Resend Invoice/Purchase transaction bearing that invoice number first
400 E705 Invalid transaction flag Ensure you are using the accepted values for Flag (case sensitive)
400 E706 Invalid transaction currency Ensure you are using the accepted values for Currency (case sensitive)
400 E707 Invalid total amount Item Amount Value is strictly summation of Unit Price × Quantity
400 E708 Invalid total VAT Ensure you have summed up 15% of all taxable items in the payload
400 E709 Invalid total levies Ensure you have summed up 15% of Levies A, B, C, D, E of items in the payload
400 E710 Purchase already exist Invoice Number for the purchase transaction already exists on EVAT, use a new number
400 E711 Purchase was not found Ensure the invoice number for the purchase has already been sent to evat
400 E712 The purchase is already returned Purchase has already been returned
400 E713 Purchase order not found Ensure you have entered a valid purchase order number
400 E714 Purchase order in use The purchase order number has already been sent to evat, use a new one
400 E715 Invalid purchase order reference Ensure you entered a valid purchase order number
400 E716 Purchase amount exceeded Ensure the purchase amount in the return transaction is equal to purchase amount when it was sent as a purchase
400 E720 The invoice has already been refunded Issue a refund callback to see response
400 E721 Invoice credited or debited cannot be refund You can issue a full refund on a credited or debited invoice
400 E722 Credit or debit note already exist Credit or debit note number has already been sent to evat
400 E723 Duplication of invoice number Ensure that invoice number is not duplicated in the credit/debit note payload
400 E724 Credit note amount cannot be greater than invoice amount Ensure the credit note amount is lesser than the sum of invoice amounts in payload
400 E725 Refund amount exceeded invoice amount Ensure Refund amount is lower than invoice amount
400 E726 Invoice totally refunded Invoice has already been refunded, you can no longer issue a partial refund
400 E727 Invoice Already Refunded Invoice has been refunded, request for a refund callback
400 E728 Transaction(s) already exist Transaction number has already been sent to EVAT, use a new number
400 E729 Refund already cancelled Request for refund callback
400 E730 Purchase return already canceled Request for purchase return callback
400 E750 Reference is in use Reference number has already been sent to evat, use a new one
400 E751 Item category not found Ensure that item category exists in the payload
400 E801 Invalid calculation type Use either INCLUSIVE or EXCLUSIVE
400 E802 Invalid sale type Use either NORMAL or EXPORT
400 E803 Invalid discount type Use either GENERAL or SELECTIVE
400 E804 Invalid home currency exchange rate Set exchange rate to 1.0 if currency is GHS
400 E805 Invalid reference Ensure the correct reference value is used
400 E806 Invalid item category Use either "", EXM, TRSM, CST, RNT, EXC_PLASTIC
400 E807 Invalid business partner name Ensure you use the correct name as sent on day 1 or put in a request to officially change business partner name via EVAT Suite
400 E808 Invalid data, invoices duplication Ensure the payload is not broken
400 E809 Invalid currency Use the approved currencies
400 E810 Invalid exchange rate Ensure exchange rate is not 0 or less
400 E811 Invalid business partner Ensure you use the correct name as sent on day 1 or put in a request to officially change business partner name via EVAT Suite
400 E812 Invalid item code Ensure item code is not more than 100 characters
400 E813 Invalid item description Ensure item description is not more than 100 characters
400 E815 Invalid item quantity Ensure value is not 0 or less
400 E816 Invalid item unit price Ensure value is not 0 or less
400 E817 Invalid total voucher Ensure value is not 0 or less
400 E818 Invalid total discount Ensure value is not 0 or less
400 E819 Invalid levy A amount Ensure value is 2.5% of item amount
400 E820 Invalid levy B amount Ensure value is 2.5% of item amount
400 E821 Invalid levy C amount Ensure value is 1% of item amount (for invoices before 2025 only)
400 E822 Invalid levy D amount Ensure value is 5% of item amount
400 E823 Invalid levy E amount Ensure value is 1% of item amount
400 E824 Invalid business partner TIN Ensure value has 11 or 13 characters
